# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 3: celestial interactions, casus belli and opinions (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Send a member of the throne's dynasty to a princely fief or a grand protectorate. The character carries
# var:oe_cel_dispatched_prince (the throne); W4 on_character_death reads it.
oe_cel_chi_dispatch_prince = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes
	ai_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
			has_ruler = yes
			ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
			any_subject = {
				OR = {
					is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
					is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 50
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			is_regent = no
			has_dynasty = yes
			dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_cel_chi_choose_subject"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_cel_chi_no_subject"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			OR = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cel_chi_cd_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cel_dispatch_cd } }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -50
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_dispatched_prince value = scope:actor }
				move_country = scope:target
			}
			scope:target = {
				add_liberty_desire = -15
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_cel_dispatch_cd years = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

# 2. Recall Prince to Imperial Guard (v12.0 Celestial 2.0): pulls a dispatched or dynastic prince from a fanwang / grand_duhu court back to the capital.
# Note: character_interactions do not use ai_prerequisite in EU5 1.4.9; AI gating sits inside ai_will_do while potential restricts to the Celestial Emperor.
oe_cel_chi_recall_prince = {
	message = yes
	on_other_nation = yes
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 720

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
			has_ruler = yes
			any_subject = {
				OR = {
					is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
					is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			government_power >= 10
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_cel_recall_prince_cd
		years = 5
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_subject = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
							is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
						}
					}
					every_character = {
						limit = {
							is_alive = yes
							is_adult = yes
							is_ruler = no
							is_heir = no
							owner != scope:actor
							OR = {
								AND = {
									has_variable = oe_cel_dispatched_prince
									var:oe_cel_dispatched_prince ?= scope:actor
								}
								AND = {
									has_dynasty = yes
									scope:actor = { has_ruler = yes ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes } }
									dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
								}
							}
						}
						add_to_list = source
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "oe_cel_chi_recall_select_character"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_cel_chi_recall_no_character"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			owner != scope:actor
			owner = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
		}
		enabled = {
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:recipient = {
				owner = { save_scope_as = oe_cel_recall_from_subject }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_dispatched_prince }
					remove_variable = oe_cel_dispatched_prince
				}
				move_country = scope:actor
				add_character_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_cel_recalled_court_guard_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_government_power = -10
				add_prestige = 5
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_recalled_princes_count } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_recalled_princes_count value = 0 }
				}
				change_variable = { name = oe_cel_recalled_princes_count add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_ev30_cd } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_ev30_cd years = 10 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.30
				}
			}
			scope:oe_cel_recall_from_subject ?= {
				add_liberty_desire = -8
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_recalled_prince }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -20
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes
					oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
					at_war = no
					stability >= 10
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					exists = owner
					owner = { subject_loyalty < 45 }
				}
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}
